summary: Iteration 12 — Full-stack testing of three new features: scheduled school posts (with cron), WhatsApp/link share, and ADULT_LEARNER learning path. 12/12 backend pytest cases PASS. End-to-end UI flows verified across SCHOOL / ADULT_LEARNER / PARENT roles. No critical or minor bugs found.

SCHOOL /dashboard/actualites.create_scheduled: news-schedule datetime-local filled → publish button label switches to 'Programmer' → toast 'Programmée pour le 3 oct. 2026, 03:47' ✓
SCHOOL /dashboard/actualites.news-publish-now-<id>: post moves from À venir to En ligne, publish-now button disappears ✓
SCHOOL /dashboard/actualites.share buttons on own published post: share-whatsapp-<id> + share-copy-<id> present; href = https://wa.me/?text=<school name> — <title>%0A<url with /ecoles/<slug>#actualites>  ✓

ADULT_LEARNER /dashboard.goal_add: goal-input + goal-add create a new goal ✓
ADULT_LEARNER /dashboard.persistence_after_reload: goal still present after full reload ✓

PARENT /dashboard/fil.note: Buttons present on each feed post.

critical_code_review_comments: Backend update_post (PUT /schools/me/posts/{id}): the check `if post.get('status','published') == 'published'` prevents rescheduling an already-published post (good), but if a legacy post has no `status` field, it defaults to 'published' and strips scheduled_at — intentional and correct. However the else-branch always forces status to 'scheduled' or 'draft' — a currently-'scheduled' post edited WITHOUT scheduled_at will silently become a Brouillon. The UI prefills scheduled_at via toLocalInput so in practice this is OK, but worth a comment or UI confirmation.

notify_post_followers iterates followers sequentially inside an async-for. For schools with many followers (hundreds), consider batching notifications via bulk insert into db.notifications (one insert_many) to reduce round-trips.

SharePost.jsx uses navigator.clipboard.writeText with a bare try/catch — on insecure contexts or browsers without clipboard API it falls back to toast.error('Copie impossible'). Consider a document.execCommand('copy') fallback for broader compatibility.

publish_scheduled_posts (cron handler) does the publish+notify loop sequentially per post. If many posts are due at once the request could exceed cron timeout. Consider processing in parallel with asyncio.gather or capping per-call to a configurable batch size (already limited to 200 by to_list).
SchoolNews.jsx is now ~127 lines, dense inline PostRow component — fine as-is but splitting PostRow into its own file would reduce diff-noise in future iterations.
seed_data_creation: Test posts created with prefix 'TEST_UI_sched_' and 'TEST_now_' were deleted at end of flows. One pre-existing TEST_sched_* post from an earlier curl run is visible in the parent feed (school: Test School). Non-blocking; can be purged manually if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All three features in iteration 12 are fully functional end-to-end. Login route is /connexion (NOT /login). Scheduled posts: new PostBody.scheduled_at (ISO) + status in ('scheduled','draft','published'); PUBLISHED_Q filter excludes scheduled from /schools/{id}/posts and /feed. publish-now and unschedule endpoints at POST /schools/me/posts/{id}/{publish-now,unschedule}. Cron: POST /api/cron/publish-scheduled-posts, Bearer WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET. Learner goals persist at users.learner_profile.goals_list. SharePost component wraps WhatsApp (wa.me link with text=`<school> — <title>\n<url>`) + copy-link using navigator.clipboard.
